company_description: Getlink SE, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, finance, construction, and operation of fixed link infrastructure and transport system in France and the United Kingdom. It operates through Eurotunnel, Europorte, and ElecLink segments. The Eurotunnel segment operates tunnels of a length of approximately 50 kilometres each under the English Channel, as well as terminals at Folkestone in the United Kingdom and the Coquelles in France. It also provides passenger shuttle services for the transport of trucks, cars, motor homes, caravans, coaches, motorcycles, trailers, commercial vans, and other vehicles. In addition, this segment manages passenger trains and rail freight, as well as fixed equipment and related installations. Its Europorte segment offers a range of integrated rail freight services, including national and international haulage, local services for secondary lines, individual junction management, infrastructure maintenance, and wagon loading and unloading services. description.long_fr: Getlink est l'opérateur du tunnel sous la Manche via sa concession Eurotunnel. Le groupe exploite les navettes Le Shuttle (passagers et fret) et les sillons ferroviaires (Eurostar, fret). Il développe également ElecLink (interconnexion électrique France-Royaume-Uni). Concession expirant 2086.
description.long_en: Getlink is the operator of the Channel Tunnel through its Eurotunnel concession. The group operates Le Shuttle shuttles (passengers and freight) and rail paths (Eurostar, freight). It also develops ElecLink (France-UK electricity interconnector). Concession expiring 2086.
description.long_de: Getlink ist Betreiber des Kanaltunnels über seine Konzession Eurotunnel. Der Konzern betreibt die Shuttle‑Verbindungen (Passagiere und Fracht) und die Eisenbahnschienen (Eurostar, Fracht). Zudem entwickelt er ElecLink (elektrische Stromverbindung Frankreich‑Vereinigtes Königreich). Die Konzession läuft bis 2086.
